description: This file contains unit tests for the PermissionManager component, focusing on verifying permission statuses and ensure functions for voice wake, location, and other capabilities within an iOS/macOS app.

classes.name: PermissionManagerTests
classes.description: Test suite struct that includes multiple test functions for permission-related features.

methods.name: voice wake permission helpers match status
methods.description: Verifies that the granted voice wake permissions match the ensured permissions when not interactive.

methods.name: status can query non interactive caps
methods.description: Checks that the permission status queries for a set of capabilities return the expected number of results.

methods.name: ensure non interactive does not throw
methods.description: Asserts that ensuring permissions for certain capabilities in a non-interactive context does not throw errors and returns correct count.

methods.name: location status matches authorization always
methods.description: Ensures the location permission status query aligns with the CLLocationManager authorization status.

methods.name: ensure location non interactive matches authorization always
methods.description: Verifies that the ensure function for location permissions in non-interactive mode matches the authorization status.
